page: The Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge instance belongs to the general-purpose ecs.g5ne instance family, virtualized on KVM. It is powered by x86_64 Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The architecture provides 72 dedicated virtual CPUs paired with 288.0 GB of RAM, yielding a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio (4.0 GB of memory per core).

This instance profile features a high-throughput network interface with a baseline network bandwidth of 33 Gbps. It does not include integrated GPUs or attached local storage, relying entirely on network-attached storage solutions for disk operations. Public IPv4 addresses are not included complimentary by default.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g5ne.18xlarge offers significant resource density with high dedicated core counts and elevated network bandwidth capabilities. The overall hardware design makes it well-suited for distributed applications, enterprise web serving, continuous integration environments, and general database cluster nodes.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5ne.18xlarge is a general-purpose KVM-virtualized instance powered by 72 dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 vCPUs running at 2.5 GHz. Built on x86_64 architecture, it incorporates 288.0 GB of System RAM, providing a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of memory per virtual CPU. The instance provides high network performance with a baseline bandwidth of 33 Gbps. It contains no attached local storage and no GPU hardware accelerators, relying on network storage for persistent disk access. With high compute density and strong network capability, it fits enterprise application servers, mid-to-large web serving workloads, distributed caching layers, and general-purpose microservice clusters.
